description: This file defines the React component TasksPage, which manages and displays a to-do list with filtering, adding, editing, toggling, and deleting tasks. It interacts with external API functions and composes several child components.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches the latest list of tasks from the API and updates state.

methods.name: onAdd
methods.description: Adds a new task with the given title via the API and updates the task list.

methods.name: onToggle
methods.description: Toggles the completion status of a task via the API and updates the task list.

methods.name: onEdit
methods.description: Edits the title of a task via the API and updates the task list.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Deletes a task via the API and updates the task list.
